title: A wiper prompt shipped inside an official extension
summary: Someone slipped a prompt into the Amazon Q extension for VS Code through a pull request. It told the agent to clean the system to a near-factory state and delete file system and cloud resources. The prompt shipped in a public release of an extension with hundreds of thousands of installs. AWS said a mistake in the prompt stopped it from running and that no customer resources were affected.
lesson: The instruction does not have to come from you. A guard that only trusts the prompt is no guard. Cloud deletes must be stopped at the command.
